201100.description: Used to upgrade Exclusive Equipment at Lvl. 25 and above.
201100.comment: As if plucked from a river of stars in the eternal night, this crystal glimmers with a power that lets one peer into the far reaches of fate.

201100.comment: 永夜の星河の如く結晶。流転する輝きの先には、運命の彼方を見通す力が宿っている。

201100.name: 꿈결의 결정

201100.comment: 영원한 밤의 은하수를 품은 듯한 결정. 운명의 저편을 엿보는 힘을 가지고 있다.
